text: Adhesive dispenser is putting out about a third less glue than it should, but pump pressure looks normal. Probably something partly blocking the tip.
Adhesive dispenser pump motor is drawing over 15 amps and the motor controller is showing a fault code.
We need to open up the AGV charging dock to repair the receiver plate. Need it de-energized and locked out first.
Start of the day, need the morning check on the AGV charging dock before we send out the first AGV.
Air compressor discharge temp is reading about 200 F and the amber warning is on. It's still running.
Air compressor oil is below the min mark on the sight glass and the low oil alarm is on. Temperature is fine.
CO detector in the boiler room just went off, reading around 40 ppm.
Boiler needs to be fully isolated and locked out for an internal inspection per the work order.
Scheduled maintenance on the capping machine, need it locked out so we can get inside.
Capping machine stopped, the drive inverter fault lamp is lit and there's an inverter fault code.
Case packer hot melt glue tank is at about 40 percent, want to top it up before the shift starts. No alarms.
Case packer former belt is cracking and fraying, time to swap it out during the maintenance window.
Refrigerant gas alarm went off in the chiller room and there's frost building up on one of the hose fittings.
Quarterly calibration is due on the chiller temperature sensors, one is reading over a degree off the reference thermometer.
CMM froze all axes with a hard fault, the probe contact force went over the limit.
CMM was powered off overnight, need to bring it up for the morning shift.
Need to start up the CNC lathe after it sat overnight, home the axes and prime the coolant.
CNC lathe coolant pressure is at 7 bar, the high pressure alarm is on.
CNC mill coolant pressure has been under the minimum setpoint for several seconds while cutting.
CNC mill chip conveyor tripped on overcurrent mid-cycle, chips aren't being cleared out.
Conveyor stopped because the infeed photo-eye tripped, but there's nothing actually blocking it.
Monthly check of the conveyor belt surface for cuts, tears and worn cover.
Coolant system pressure has slowly drifted below 15 PSI, pump is running steady.
Start of shift, need to bring the coolant system up before the machines can run.
Weekly biocide dose for the cooling tower basin is due.
Need to shut the cooling tower down in a controlled way for scheduled maintenance.
Die casting machine hydraulic supply is reading below 180 bar while it's in standby, warning alarm only.
Small coolant drip at a die cooling fitting on the die casting machine, flow down a few percent, no puddle.
Dust collector hopper isn't emptying even though the rotary valve is running, looks bridged. Also it's due for the weekly cleanout.
Dust collector hopper high level alarm, the hopper is full.
Quarterly cleaning of the busbars and inside of the electrical panel is due.
Annual calibration check on the electrical panel's power meter.
Need to get inside the filling machine guarding for a repair, lock it out first.
Filling machine is done for the day, need to shut it down properly at end of shift.
Fume extractor suction pressure is above the max setpoint, fan is pulling too hard.
Fume extractor primary filter cartridge is due for its scheduled replacement.
Heat treat furnace zone is 8 degrees over the upper limit and the high temp alarm is going.
Fire alarm and visible flames by the heat treat furnace.
HVAC air handler fan belt is glazed and cracked, can't get the tension right anymore. Needs replacing.
HVAC air handler fan is turning about 25 percent slower than commanded, motor is on.
Hydraulic power unit oil temperature is above 60 C with the cooler running.
Hydraulic power unit reservoir level is in the low zone, need to add fluid.
Hydraulic press ram is stuck halfway down and won't move up or down.
Someone hit the e-stop on the hydraulic press because of a safety hazard.
Injection molder is moving unexpectedly, need to e-stop it and put it in safe standby.
Injection molder hydraulic filter indicator is in the red bypass zone, filter needs changing.
Labeling machine web jam alarm, the labels stopped feeding.
Labeling machine applicator pad is torn and gummed up with adhesive, keeps missing labels. Replace it.
Laser cutter cut quality is getting worse, time to inspect and clean the nozzle.
Laser cutter exhaust filter pressure drop is over 1.5 inches, filter is saturated.
Leak test station fixture clamps are getting slow, the clamp rails need lubrication.
Leak test station pressure went above the upper limit while it was still filling.
Mechanical press die lube counter hit 500 strokes, change the die lubrication fluid.
Die change on the mechanical press, need full lockout before anyone goes into the tooling area.
Paint is pooling on the paint booth floor during coating, looks like a drip line came loose.
Technician needs to go inside the paint booth for maintenance, isolate and lock out everything first.
Palletizer pallet dispenser jammed, the pallet didn't separate from the stack and the sensor timed out.
Palletizer dispenser chain is ticking at the start of each drop, needs its weekly lube.
Parts washer detergent day tank high level alarm, the auto fill overfilled it.
End of shift on the parts washer, shut it down in the right order.
Smoke and flames coming off the plasma cutter table after a cut.
Plasma cutter water table is full of slag above the slats, needs draining and cleaning.
Flames outside the burner area on the powder coat oven, fire alarm is on.
Faint gas smell near the powder coat oven, sensor slightly above background but under the alarm level.
Press brake hydraulic oil is running over 55 C even though the oil level is fine, oil cooler filter is due for cleaning.
Monthly safety check on the press brake, extinguisher and e-stop circuit.
Reflow oven conveyor belt tension and wear inspection is due on the PM calendar.
Reflow oven nitrogen flow meter sensor is due for its scheduled cleaning.
Robotic welder fixture hit 250 cycles, grease the slides and clamp pivots.
Robotic welder wire feeder stopped feeding mid weld, wire jam light is on.
Gear oil leaked onto the floor next to the roller conveyor, it's a slip hazard.
Roller conveyor zone is running about 20 percent under its set speed, motor still running.
Screwdriving robot screw hopper is empty, the bowl is still running fine, we just ran out of screws.
Screwdriving robot torque went over the max limit during fastening, might be cross-threaded.
Stretch wrapper turntable speed is wobbling under constant load, check the turntable drive belt.
Stretch wrapper pre-stretch ratio drifted about 6 percent off target, needs the tension calibration.
Tooling work on the surface grinder, lock it out before anyone reaches in.
Surface grinder magnetic chuck has swarf buildup and parts aren't seating flat, chuck holding force is fine. Clean it.
Scheduled inspection of the torque station reaction bar for cracks and wear.
Torque station needs full lockout before we open it for repair.
Ultrasonic cleaner tank level dropped below half, the transducers are getting exposed. Shut it down now.
Need to work inside the ultrasonic cleaner tank, lock it out first.
VFD cabinet cooling fan is spinning below rated speed, warning only, drive still running.
VFD DC bus voltage dropped to almost zero instantly.
Start up the vibratory feeder at the beginning of the shift, safety checks are signed off.
Vibratory feeder has an odd vibration pattern, check the leaf springs.
Run the golden parts through the vision inspection station before production starts.
Need to get into the vision inspection enclosure to work on the camera, lock it out.
There's standing water on the pump station floor, no burst pipe or spray.
Water pump mechanical seal has a slow drip, less than a drop a second.
Wave solder wave is cresting unevenly, clean the nozzle and recalibrate the wave height.
Small amount of molten solder seeping from a joint on the wave solder pot, contained in the machine base.
